Ladakh imposes fines for illegal off-roading in protected areas

Authorities in Ladakh have begun imposing significant fines on tourists for engaging in illegal off-roading activities within protected wildlife areas, including Pangong Lake. The crackdown aims to protect the region's fragile ecosystem and promote responsible tourism. Fines reported range up to Rs 2 lakh, with some outlets also mentioning Rs 50,000 penalties for wildlife violations.
